name: Brass Hare
bio: Wound up every morning and never quite runs down.
notes: Downloaded by hand (owner, 2026-10-29) as an unrigged textured GLB; rigged by Meshy's rigging API (source.modelUrl "upload": the download, cut to 200k triangles, sent as a data URI; the task in source.meshy.rig). Queue note: steampunk rabbit. Was held back: A-posed arms close to the body, so the found arms and hands were off. First person: universal arms dyed brass and fur (his own hands drew huge and splayed over the grip in first person; owner's screenshot, 2026-10-30).
